sloka: तदप्यशनिसङ्काशैश्छिन्नं रामेण सायकैः ।एवमेकशतं छिन्नं शिरसां तुल्यवर्चसाम् ।। ६.११०.२९ ।।
transliteration: tadapyaśanisaṅkāśaiśchinnaṁ rāmeṇa sāyakaiḥ ।evamekaśataṁ chinnaṁ śirasāṁ tulyavarcasām ।। 6.110.29 ।।

translations.english: Rama cut off the afore said head with Indra's thunderbolt like arrows. In that way equally charming a hundred heads were struck off.
